mechanism_narrative: A higher GDP level (as measured by GDPC1) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting the positive relationship between economic activity and equity market performance.
failure_condition: GDPC1 fails to have a positive correlation with 20d S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 238.0, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL > 238.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is > -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 105.0, it indicates a strong labor market and expanding supply, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition UNRATE < 5.0 AND INDPRO > 105.0 is met but SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1000.0), the S&P 500 is expected to have negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to the risk of economic overheating and policy tightening.
failure_condition: The joint condition UNRATE < 4.0 AND HOUST > 1000.0 is met but SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is > -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is > -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as low rates support equity valuations through lower discount rates.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS fails to have a positive correlation with 60d S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it indicates a contraction in the industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is > -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting the positive impact of industrial activity on corporate earnings and equity valuations.
failure_condition: INDPRO fails to have a positive correlation with 60d S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
